text.en: Role of demonstrations is row 70 of the BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual table in the Evaluation Analysis area.
text.zh: Role of demonstrations 是 BenchCouncil AI100（2022-2023）年度表第 70 行，所属领域为“评测与分析”。

text.en: The annual table associates Role of demonstrations with “Rethinking the role of demonstrations: What makes in-context learning work?”.
text.zh: 年度表把 Role of demonstrations 与论文《Rethinking the role of demonstrations: What makes in-context learning work?》关联。

text.en: The Main Contributors field is “Sewon Min, Luke Zettlemoyer”.
text.zh: “主要人物”字段依次列出 Sewon Min（官方页拼写）、Luke Zettlemoyer（官方页拼写）；官方英文原文为“Sewon Min, Luke Zettlemoyer”。
